learning_extracted: Under theta_packet_compose_into_e3_bias=False (read-only-first) the action stream is identical across arms by construction, so behavioural readouts (proposer/committed-class) are dead discriminators; a read-only readiness gate's C1/C2 must be packet-structure metrics.

A vintage-heterogeneity gate measured on the JOINT arm conflates 'V_s vintaging machinery is live' (true; C3 + ARM_2) with 'joint-mode packets show heterogeneous vintages on this run' (false by design in the verisimilar regime); exercise the V_s-threshold hold path directly via a forced-low-V_s probe.

The component-norm-signature L1 distance is the discriminator the substrate's structure actually supports (the non-vacuity gate already uses it); C1/C2 should be built on it, not on magnitude-blind cosine over heterogeneous latent spaces.

successor_fix.c1_c2_readout: read-only structural separability: C1 = matched-cycle component-norm-signature L1 distance joint-vs-alternation; C2 = joint-vs-shuffled; each > discrimination margin AND > within-joint cross-seed baseline; corroborating cross-stream norm-covariation (joint co-varies same-cycle, shuffled decorrelated). Manifest reframed: readiness = modes non-degenerate + structurally separable; behavioural 'carries downstream signal' deferred to the compose-ON successor.
